use_case_name: Initiate and Clear Surveillance Track Alerts

claims.content: To enable a C2 JU to initiate or terminate force tell alerts on other JUs and manage emergency alerts within its own database.

goal.raw_text: To enable a C2 JU to initiate or terminate force tell alerts on other JUs and manage emergency alerts within its own database.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has the capability to initiate/terminate a force tell alert on another JU.
The appropriate condition for setting or clearing the EMG IND and FT IND exists.
A C2 JU determines the need to initiate or terminate a force tell alert on another JU, or an emergency alert condition exists for itself.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU determines the need to initiate or terminate a force tell alert on another JU, or an emergency alert condition exists for itself.

claims.content: To initiate a force tell alert on another JU, the C2 JU sets the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
The JU whose force tell status is being changed accepts and reports the change in its J2 message upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Other JUs set the alert indicator in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
To terminate a force tell alert on another JU, the C2 JU clears the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Optionally, other JUs may clear the alert indicator upon reception of a J2 message with FT IND set to value 0.
A JU shall not initiate or terminate an emergency alert on another Active JU.
The JU whose force tell status is being changed has accepted and reported the change in its J2 message.
Other JUs have set or cleared the alert indicator in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Optionally, other JUs may have cleared the alert indicator upon reception of a J2 message with FT IND set to value 0.
